capabilities: encrypt selected text within a note
decrypt notes or selections in the editor
convert existing Markdown notes to and from encrypted notes
decrypt files outside Obsidian via a CLI
extras: README carries a prominent warning that the encryption has not been independently audited and content is unrecoverable without the password; users are told to keep backups. Full documentation, release notes and issue tracker live on external pages. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; supports desktop and mobile. Author asks for donations (coffee/sponsorship).
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plaintext files, so sensitive content is readable by anyone with access to the vault or its synced copies.
summary: Encryption plugin that creates password-protected encrypted notes (.mdenc) and encrypts selected text blocks within regular Markdown notes.
